raw_text: A targeted cyber attack on ISRO's telemetry data centre in Bengaluru has raised concerns about the vulnerability of India's space infrastructure to sophisticated threat actors. The attack, which involved spear-phishing emails impersonating ISRO officials, was detected days after Chandrayaan-3's lunar landing. CERT-In has issued emergency advisories to all space sector organizations, while ISRO has confirmed that operational technology networks and mission control systems remained air-gapped and secure.
clean_text: Cyber attack on ISRO telemetry centre raises concerns about space infrastructure security. CERT-In issued advisories. ISRO confirms air-gapped mission control remained secure.
